project_tracker_diagnostic: Perennial with a basal clump and long flowering stalks; leaves often deeply lobed; yellow rays commonly 8–15 around a yellow disk; heads on long naked peduncles.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.habit: Basal rosette or low crown sending up long flowering stalks.
morphology_keys.leaves: Mostly basal to lower cauline, deeply pinnatifid to pinnate-lobed; rough or hairy.
morphology_keys.heads: Yellow rays surrounding yellow disks; heads solitary or few on long peduncles.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: In several series, green, often appressed.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
